# Study session planner

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/study-plan/

Plan focus blocks and breaks within a chosen number of study minutes. See a simple sequence you can copy and follow without creating calendar events.

## How to use it

1. Choose a study tool and review its input labels.
2. Enter your scores, course details, passage or available study time.
3. Run the tool and review the result and its assumptions.

## Example

Fit 25-minute focus blocks and five-minute breaks into a two-hour study window.

## Limits and checks

The plan is a local text schedule. It does not create reminders, send notifications or reserve calendar time.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
